steps.content: ??:?? Eighteenth floor, Statue of Keylan
The exchange of fire between gangs made a massive breach on the outer wall of the statue, exposing an internal fire escape.
Standing on the ladder is a tall, thin man holding an umbrella. He looks down at the conference hall, as well as the square in general.
Oh, I'm still here. What a magnificent view! It makes my labors all worthwhile.
A long-lost miracle will soon happen. How are you feeling now? Happier?
Haha, my apologies for keeping you waiting. Things change, we must adjust our plan in time. Will you forgive me?
After all, this multi-year project is done, and I've overachieved.
An explosion happens in the conference hall. Purple light and crowds of sharp spikes overturn the roof of the building. The loud boom shakes the floor beneath the man's feet.
Does the noise bother you? We've got a couple of little intruders who are trying to put together an opening act for us.

They call this thing <color=#fb9259>Shackles</color>, right? They've probably modified the technology they had stolen back then and used it to tie up a few lambs. That has brought a little accident to our plan.
Then again, thanks to them, we've found such good seeds.
Syndicate has nurtured the best seeds, so powerful, so pure, so passionate and fearless—the ones who dare to oppose the gods, and are thus favored by them.
It doesn't matter if they've already been marked by others, we just have to snatch them.
He watches the exposed battlefield and the person throwing up blood.
Alas, the pitiful and lovable ones, continue with your hopeless struggle. Such admirable willpower will make an excellent decoration for the <color=#fb9259>Ring</color> too.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief... Are you... all right?
Ashen-faced, Hecate is holding your hand shakily. Hella is also very weak. 036 is left outside, unsure if dead or alive.
The bloody flesh with one eye open is slowly merging into Zoya's body, its evil eye glaring at you. You can feel the strong hatred, jealousy, and mockery in it.

steps.speaker: Zoya?
steps.content: Destroy... End... end all of this!
Using the shackles on Zoya again will only further burden Hella and Hecate. But there's no way back for you. You must fight.
Her battle shouldn't have been like this. You can't let her be taken away.

options: I'm sorry, Hecate. Please lend me your power one more time

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: I will, anytime.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Stop her, Chief. Only you can do it.
